name: Nippon Fusso India Pvt. Ltd.
india_angle: Nippon Fusso India Pvt. Ltd. is the Indian subsidiary, indicating a strategic presence in the Indian market.
summary: Nippon Fluorine Co., Ltd. specializes in fluorine resin coatings and processing, which are essential in semiconductor manufacturing for protective and insulating purposes. Their products are used in advanced packaging and automotive semiconductor applications.
